attempted_claim: Let F_{8,2×1/2(1,1,1)} be the moduli family of primary genus-8 Q-Fano threefolds with two terminal quotient points of type 1/2(1,1,1). Determine its exact K-stability stratification: for every Q-Fano member X represented by the twisted-cubic construction, including special members, decide whether δ(X)<1, δ(X)=1, or δ(X)>1; in the equality case identify all zero-β valuations and determine which are product-type, thereby deciding precisely which members are K-polystable.
decisive_failure: The exact K-stability stratification for every Q-Fano member of the genus-8 two-point family remains open: special members on the boundary of the twisted-cubic parameter space are unstratified, their delta signs uncomputed, and zero-beta/product-type classification undone. The published literature covers only the general member. Session artifacts establish only standard numerics and a pre-geometry sensitivity diagnostic, not any classification result.
